overview: The Akheva Border marks the outermost reach of ancient Akheva influence.
details: Alien pylons and vacuum-carved stone corridors hint at deeper structures beneath the surface. Constructs patrol silently, responding to resonance anomalies.
hooks: An Akheva pylon activates after centuries of silence.
A resonance fracture opens toward the deeper ruins.
Construct patrols intensify without known cause.
A vacuum predator pack approaches the border.
